questions.q: The primary purpose of preparing an Income and Expenditure Account for a not-for-profit organization is to determine the
options: Surplus or deficit for the financial year
Total cash receipts and payments during the year
Total value of assets owned by the club
questions.explain: The **Income and Expenditure Account** is the non-profit equivalent of a Profit and Loss Account. It matches revenue income against revenue expenditure for a specific period to calculate the net result, which is termed a **surplus** (if income > expenditure) or a **deficit** (if expenditure > income).
